purpose: Require positive source-identifiable and ordered block-temporal information from M2 on synthetic member-held-out evidence before any measured PMFS replay can authorise runtime.

units.clusters: House x frozen route index 0..9 x held-out transport member 0..7
units.pseudo_observations_per_cluster: every candidate source in that House, scored only for rank aggregation inside its cluster
units.independent_n_for_inference: clusters, never sources, blocks, transitions or updates

strict_member_LOO.heldout_observation: the five ordered block counts of source s and held-out member h
strict_member_LOO.calibration_Q_minus_h: exclude every ordered member pair in which either member equals h
strict_member_LOO.candidate_predictive_members: the seven members other than h
strict_member_LOO.coherent_score: logmeanexp over predictive member m outside the product of five aligned block emission probabilities
strict_member_LOO.prior: rank likelihood only; do not use q0, native PMFS or truth

controls.BLOCK_ORDER_PERMUTE: one deterministic non-identity permutation of the five pseudo-observed block counts per cluster; preserve its histogram
controls.INCOHERENT_PER_BLOCK: sum over blocks of logmeanexp across predictive members, allowing the member to switch
controls.WITHIN_BLOCK_PERMUTE: any permutation of the three stop labels must be exactly invariant before block counts are formed
controls.CANDIDATE_PERMUTE: restored candidate scores must match within 1e-12

downstream: Only a complete premise PASS permits the same frozen run to write measured Stage-1 posteriors. Premise failure stops V3 before native PMFS or localization truth is opened.
